description: SSA stress-balance boundary traces using the verification test V 'circular flat-bottomed continent' (CFBC) configuration: the van der Veen flow-line floating shelf with the calving-front stress boundary condition. One SSA solve; the exact solution H(x), u(x) = V0*H0/H(x), v = 0 is known at every cell.

regenerate.command: cd stage1 && source runs/env.sh && instrument/instrument_ssa -Mx 61 -My 3 -dumps_dir stage1/dumps/ssa
regenerate.note: Override grid with -Mx/-My and output with -dumps_dir. The PISM CI canonical grid is -Mx 201 -My 3.

setup.flow_law: isothermal_glen with B = 1.9e8 Pa s^(1/n) (set via flow_law.isothermal_Glen.ice_softness = B^-n)

van_der_Veen.note: C is the 'typical constant ice parameter'; corresponds to the isothermal Glen B = 1.9e8

dump_files.meta.txt: pism revision, config file, grid, command line
dump_files.parameters.csv: stress_balance.ssa.*, flow_law.*, constants.*, grid.*, basal_resistance.* config keys
dump_files.inputs.nc: all inputs + outputs (usurf, thk, topg, mask, tauc, bc_mask, bc_values, enthalpy, velocity, F_b, driving stress, nuH, ice hardness)
dump_files.columns.csv: per cell: geometry, tauc, computed u/v/F_b/taud_x/taud_y/nuH/Bbar, exact H/u/v

checks.Bbar: ice hardness = 1.9e8 Pa s^(1/n) everywhere (isothermal Glen)
checks.exact_solution: computed u matches the van der Veen exact solution: average error 0.077% at Mx=61 (max vector err 1.32 m/yr near the calving front)
checks.taud: driving stress decreases downstream with thickness
